id: Settle For Less Before You Exit
folderName: Settle For Less Before You Exit
setting: デートをドタキャンされた友人Aに対し、ずっと見守ってきた幼馴染・男友達Bが「彼ではなく僕を選んで」と熱く語りかけるシーン。
lyrics:
Everybody deserves somebody,
But, girl, nobody can love you like I do.

You could be a super model,
President or write a novel.
But he's holding you back
And you're better than that.
He won't even buy you flowers,
Stay up late and talk for hours.
I think I can do that
I can be better than that.
You should know...

Everybody deserves somebody,
But, girl, nobody can love you like I do.
And I'm not perfect but you're so worth it.
I wanna change the world for you,
So baby don't settle for less.
You deserve the best,
You're better than the rest
And I can be the best,
So baby don't settle for less.

I've been watching from the sidelines
His mistakes become my guidelines.
'Cause he's holding you back
And you're better than that.
I will love to buy you flowers,
Take the time to talk for hours.
Yeah I can do that.
I can be better than that.
You should know...

Everybody deserves somebody,
But, girl, nobody can love you like I do.
And I'm not perfect but you're so worth it.
I wanna change the world for you,
So baby don't settle for less.
You deserve the best,
You're better than the rest
And I can be the best,
So baby don't settle for less.
You deserve the best,
You're better than the rest
And I can be the best,
So baby don't settle for less.

He takes you for granted,
Girl, I can't stand it.
Watching you panic over him.
See he's just a nobody
I can be somebody,
Someone to love til' the end.

'Cause everybody deserves somebody,
But, girl, nobody can love you like I do.
And I'm not perfect but you're so worth it.
I wanna change the world for you
So baby don't settle for less.
You deserve the best,
You're better than the rest
And I can be the best
So baby don't settle for less.
You deserve the best,
You're better than the rest
And I can be the best
So baby don't settle for less.

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: He forgot our plans again. I feel stupid for still waiting.
sentences.displayHtml: He forgot our plans again. I feel stupid for still waiting.

conversation.japanese: また約束を忘れられたの。まだ待ってる自分がバカみたい。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: Sarah, he takes you for granted. You keep giving, and he barely tries.
sentences.displayHtml: Sarah, he takes you for granted. You keep giving, and he barely tries.

conversation.japanese: サラ、彼は君を当たり前に思ってるよ。君ばかり頑張って、彼はほとんど努力してない。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: Maybe I'm asking for too much. I just wanted him to care a little more.
sentences.displayHtml: Maybe I'm asking for too much. I just wanted him to care a little more.

conversation.japanese: 私が求めすぎなのかな。もう少し大事にしてほしかっただけなんだけど。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: That's not too much. Everybody deserves somebody who shows up, listens, and makes time.
sentences.displayHtml: That's not too much. Everybody deserves somebody who shows up, listens, and makes time.

conversation.japanese: それは求めすぎじゃないよ。誰にだって、ちゃんと向き合ってくれる人がふさわしいんだ。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I guess I know that. It's just hard to walk away.
sentences.displayHtml: I guess I know that. It's just hard to walk away.

conversation.japanese: たぶん分かってる。でも離れるのって難しいの。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: I've been watching from the sidelines, and I can see he's holding you back.
sentences.displayHtml: I've been watching from the sidelines, and I can see he's holding you back.

conversation.japanese: 僕はずっとそばで見てきた。それに、彼が君の足を引っ張ってるのが分かる。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: You really think I deserve better?
sentences.displayHtml: You really think I deserve better?

conversation.japanese: 私にはもっといい人がふさわしいって本当に思う？

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: I do. And I'm not perfect, but I'd never make you feel like you had to beg for love.
sentences.displayHtml: I do. And I'm not perfect, but I'd never make you feel like you had to beg for love.

conversation.japanese: 思うよ。僕は完璧じゃないけど、愛されるためにお願いしなきゃいけないなんて思わせない。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: Why are you saying all this now?
sentences.displayHtml: Why are you saying all this now?

conversation.japanese: どうして今そんなこと言うの？

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: Because nobody can love you like I do, and you're so worth it. Don't settle for less.
sentences.displayHtml: Because nobody can love you like I do, and you're so worth it. Don't settle for less.

conversation.japanese: だって、僕ほど君を愛せる人はいないし、君にはそれだけの価値があるから。妥協しないで。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: Tom... are you saying you want to be that person for me?
sentences.displayHtml: Tom... are you saying you want to be that person for me?

conversation.japanese: トム……あなたがその人になりたいって言ってるの？

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: Yes. I can be somebody, someone who loves you til' the end.
sentences.displayHtml: Yes. I can be somebody, someone who loves you til' the end.

conversation.japanese: うん。僕は君にとって特別な人になれる。最後まで君を愛する人に。
